# Hobby Shop Backend MCP

The SQL MCP server uses the existing `WebAPI/appsettings.json` connection string. MCP database tools are read-only: only `SELECT` and `WITH` queries are permitted. Do not add write operations to the MCP server.

SDK references:
- https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk
- https://modelcontextprotocol.io/
